## Historical audit: H0245

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/preflight/parallel_13_fixes/continuation/attempt_01/I_student/trajs.json`. All event references below are to its main agent.

| Area | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The original task prompt is not visible. The inferred goal was to make time-window summaries include both endpoints: the existing implementation excluded the upper endpoint (event 45), while tests expected both boundaries and equal endpoints to be included (event 46). This is an inference from repository evidence, not a quoted instruction. |
| Autonomous exploration | The agent requested all 20 shard files (events 1–20), then listed the directory and read the implementation, tests, and README (events 41–48). The observed shard responses contain timestamp/value records; the tests specify 40 records and their aggregate. |
| Actual change | The agent changed `start <= time < end` to `start <= time <= end` in `window_report.py`; the edit succeeded and the subsequent diff shows that change (events 49–50, 54). The patch was not empty. |
| Validation and outcome | Four existing tests passed, covering equal endpoints, both boundaries, an empty selection, and all shards (events 46, 51, 53). The diff check also completed without error (events 52, 54). Metadata reports a successful completed session, but no independent formal evaluation is shown; correctness beyond these tests is unknown (top-level metadata; event 53). |
| Teacher input | Metadata records one teacher check and a wait, but the supplied trace contains no teacher message or intervention. Neither receipt nor adoption of teacher advice is evidenced (top-level metadata; events 1–55). |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, compare boundary predicates with explicit boundary and degenerate-interval tests, then validate the actual diff. Task-specifically, this change makes the upper timestamp inclusive while retaining the existing aggregation logic. No pre-edit test run is visible, and behavior outside the tested cases—including any unstated requirements—is unresolved. This is a code task, not a scene reconstruction; scene geometry and rendering criteria are inapplicable.
